FOUR ALTERNATIVES. FOUR DIFFERENT REASONS.

BookThatApp alternatives.
Keep the rental rules in the comparison.

Replacing BookThatApp requires more than matching a calendar screenshot. The app lists rental formats, resources, deposits and bonds, with paid plans capped by monthly booking count. Your alternative needs to preserve the resource and payment rules that make the rental operation work.

↔↔↔↔

What would make switching worthwhile?

BookThatApp explicitly addresses several rental and reservation scenarios. If its resource and deposit/bond workflow fits your business, compare the appropriate plan before assuming a general appointment app is a substitute.

YOUR DECISION STARTS HERE

The differences that matter for BookThatApp users.

01

Monthly booking volume

Lite is $25 for 50 monthly bookings, Premium $49.95 for 350, and Business $110 for 1,000. Model peak season rather than only a quiet month.

02

Booking deposits versus bonds

Premium explicitly lists deposits and bonds. A competing app’s partial payment is not proof of an equivalent damage-bond workflow.

03

Developer requirements

Business lists API access. Cowlendar also has a beta public API, but endpoint coverage and operational fit need a separate check.

YOUR MIGRATION CHECKLIST

Test the reason you are switching.

  1. Recreate the most difficult overlap Test two bookings competing for the same item or property across intersecting date ranges. Verify pickup, return and turnaround rules.
  2. Separate every payment purpose Record the rental advance, remaining balance, damage bond and refund process. Get explicit confirmation for each in the destination app.
  3. Keep resource identities and open rentals Reconcile the individual equipment, current reservations and unpaid balances before moving live availability.

BookThatApp alternatives: common questions.

Which BookThatApp price should a rental business compare?

Use the plan that covers both monthly booking volume and the required features. Premium lists deposits/bonds and 350 bookings; Business lists 1,000 bookings and API access.

Can Cowlendar replace every BookThatApp workflow?

That depends on the operation. Cowlendar documents multiday booking and equipment availability, but a damage bond, custom API workflow or specialized rental rule requires its own confirmation.
